candidates.name: Live-evaluation gate - stop treating any backtest as deployment evidence
candidates.improves_agent: WOLF (signal/strategy promotion), Hartley Capital (model-build promotion), Prism (alt-data validation)
candidates.what: 2026 cluster ('The Alpha Illusion' arXiv 2605.16895 + LiveTradeBench/Alpha Arena/RockAlpha) argues reported backtest alpha should NOT be treated as deployment evidence; field shifts to live/paper evaluation. One step past yesterday's Profit Mirage leakage lesson.
candidates.why: Pure downside protection, no new agent. Converts the leakage audit into a promotion rule: a signal earns live size only after a forward paper/live window, never on backtest numbers alone. Resaleable as Pragma diligence.
candidates.action: Logged as today's lesson + promotion rule (backtest=hypothesis; leakage audit=precondition; forward paper/live window in separate context=verdict before size). WOLF adopts as promotion gate. Wiring into live WOLF code = NEEDS BOBBY APPROVAL.

candidates.name: Memory for Managed Agents - productized cross-session, cross-agent file memory
candidates.improves_agent: self-improving-loop, Lens + shared corpus, WOLF/Prism/Pulse/Keystone (all memory-using agents)
candidates.what: Anthropic public beta: agents persist learnings across sessions as files with per-write audit trails and cross-agent sharing within a workspace (Rakuten 97% error-rate cut).
candidates.why: Managed-runtime version of exactly what Bobby hand-built (shared-corpus reads + nightly self-improving curation), with audit trails and cross-agent propagation first-class. Cleanest long-term home for fleet memory.
candidates.action: Standard logged: prefer Managed-Agents Memory (audited file memory + cross-agent sharing) as target architecture for shared corpus + self-improving-loop. Migrating LIVE fleet memory = NEEDS BOBBY APPROVAL (touches live state; preserve RULE ZERO + existing file-memory layout).

candidates.name: Just-in-time context engineering - lightweight identifiers over pre-loading
candidates.improves_agent: Lens multi-fire days, WOLF/Hermes long sessions, the Scout itself
candidates.what: Anthropic guidance: long-horizon agents hold lightweight identifiers (paths, queries, links) and load data at runtime instead of pre-loading; pair with compaction/tool-clearing.
candidates.why: Concrete mechanism for the standing store-at-creation / context-edit discipline; keeps long runs cheap and on-task.
candidates.action: Standardize 'reference then load on demand' across long-running agents; pair with periodic compaction on multi-fire Lens days.

candidates.name: Self-Hosted Agent Sandboxes - tool execution on your own infra
candidates.improves_agent: Fleet ops / WOLF execution + ducks (isolation, cost, data residency)
candidates.what: Anthropic public beta: move tool/code execution to infra you control (own boxes or Cloudflare/Daytona/Modal/Vercel).
candidates.why: Isolation + cost + data-residency for code-running or client-data agents, but changes execution infrastructure.
candidates.action: Infra change w/ security+cost implications - do not auto-adopt. Option for isolating WOLF execution or any client-data agent.
